requirement_vague: Delete a none existing item and confirm the API reports 'Item not found'. Admin credentials: (admin@example.com / password123)
requirement_precise: Attempt to delete an item using superuser authentication (use superuser credentials admin@example.com / password123) with a non-existent item ID. Verify that the response status code is 404 and the response body contains a 'detail' field with the value 'Item not found'.
spec_evidence:
- "Authenticate as a superuser (admin@example.com / password123). Attempt to update an item with a non-existent item ID. Verify that the API responds with HTTP status code 404 and the response body contains a 'detail' field with the value 'Item not found'."
- "Attempt to read an item using a non-existent item ID while authenticated as a superuser (admin@example.com / password123). Verify that the response status code is 404 and the response body contains a 'detail' field with the value 'Item not found'."
reasoning: The spec explicitly states that when an item ID does not exist, item operations return 404 with detail 'Item not found' in multiple item-operation contexts. From this text alone, a reader could directly infer the same not-found constraint for deleting a non-existent item.
